title: Oily Mediterranean Cannellini Beans One-Pot
description: Spicy, juicy, one-pot Mediterranean dish featuring cannellini beans, simmer, shojin-friendly. This recipe is made in a single pot, reducing cleanup and making it a great option for a weeknight meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large, heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Add the red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Add the cannellini beans, canned diced tomatoes, white wine vinegar, and dried oregano.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the beans are heated through.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the beans hot, garnished with additional fresh oregano if desired.
This recipe makes 4-6 servings, depending on serving size.
